title: Container With Most Water
keyIdea: Start with the widest container (both ends). Area = width × shorter line. Move the shorter line inward: any narrower container using it is still limited by it, so it can't do better. Track the best area. O(n).

approaches.name: Brute force: every pair
approaches.idea: Try every pair i < j and compute (j − i) × min(height[i], height[j]).

approaches.name: Two pointers, move the shorter line
approaches.idea: left = 0, right = n − 1. Update ans with the current area, then move whichever line is shorter.
approaches.why: Each step moves one pointer inward: at most n steps.

options: Every narrower container that keeps it is limited by it and narrower, so it can't be better
